content:
Today, Numina is releasing NuminaMath-LEAN, a large-scale dataset of 100K mathematical competition problems formalized in Lean. The dataset comes with over 9400 complete human-formalized proofs, as well as additional proofs derived from the Kimina prover.

We hope that this data will be useful in the training and evaluation of models in the future. 

YrcCZYcgVEtKoRmN2sLVR.png

With the 2025 IMO finished, Numina now hopes to focus more on undergraduate/research level math. We are excited to see what we can do in these areas to contribute to the Lean/mathlib community moving forward!

If you are interested in collaborating or discussing with us, feel free to reach out to us at contact@projectnumina.ai, or in the discussion thread.
